name: Cat Form
tooltip:
Cat Form
55% of base mana
Instant
Requires Druid
Requires level 20
Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing Attack Power by 12 plus Agility.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
